description: Adversarial convergence-law rounds, read by BOTH implementations of the law: the Python reference behavior (skills/rpi/tests/test_run_once.py) and the workflow (tests/scripts/agentops-product-boundary.bats drives workflows/rpi.js). A case that only one side reads proves nothing about parity, which is exactly how the continuous-rename hole survived: the class conditions were tested in Python only. `digest` is a single character each suite expands to a 64-character hex digest; `class` is omitted when the finding carries none.

cases.name: continuous-rename
cases.description: f1[X] -> f2[X] -> f3[X]: the open set never grows, no id reopens, and every round names a fresh id for the SAME kind. A newly minted id is not a survivor, so the class it carries reopens the moment its only prior carrier resolves.

findings.summary: the seal is pinned at the wrong layer
the seal pin is not enforced

cases.name: classless-middle-round
cases.description: f1[X] -> f2[no class] -> f3[X]: the rename hides behind one classless round. The class retired in round 1 must still be remembered in round 2.

findings.summary: an unrelated defect with no nameable kind
the seal pin is not enforced

cases.name: simultaneous-id-and-class-reopen
cases.description: The round reopens a closed id AND that id's closed class. The id is the more specific diagnosis and leads, but the class disposition is reported independently rather than swallowed by the precedence.

cases.name: distinct-classes-run-on
cases.description: Three rounds, three different kinds, each genuinely repaired. The class law must not fire: it exists to catch renaming, not progress.

findings.summary: the evidence names no subject digest

cases.name: blank-class
cases.description: A present-but-blank class is a malformed round key, not an absent one: reading it as 'no kind' silently disarms the class law.

cases.name: duplicate-ids
cases.description: One leg naming the same id twice must be rejected, never folded last-write-wins: the id is the law's identity, and a silent fold makes 'the set did not grow' meaningless.

findings.summary: a different defect wearing the same id

cases.name: fail-without-findings
cases.description: A FAIL that names nothing to repair is a verdict without a subject: the repair stage would have nothing to fix and the law nothing to measure.
